description: Deterministic auto_approve/human_review/reject verdict for a planned remediation action (block_ip, quarantine_host, halt_pipeline, etc.) against an actor/sector/region context. Built on the same capability x opportunity x intent scoring as /ot/threat-score, with auditable rules layered on top — no LLM in the decision path. auto_approve requires vendor_stack; omitting it caps the verdict at human_review regardless of score. Price: $0.12 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

actor.description: ICS threat actor name e.g. SANDWORM, VOLTZITE, XENOTIME

asset_context.description: Optional free text, e.g. 'shared_infra:cloudflare' — escalates to human_review when shared cloud/CDN infra is detected

region.description: Target region e.g. GCC, KSA, UAE, Europe

sector.description: Target sector e.g. energy, water, manufacturing

vendor_stack.description: Comma-separated vendor list e.g. 'Schneider Modicon,Siemens SIMATIC'. REQUIRED for auto_approve to be reachable at all; omitting it caps the verdict at human_review.

name: getActionConformance
title: Remediation Action Risk Gate
